name: @caveman/cli
description: Caveman CLI — wrap any coding agent with a local byte-safe compression + truthful-metering proxy (`caveman claude`), and drive Caveman Cloud from the terminal. Compression/metering run in companion Go binaries: run `caveman setup` to see install state. Savings are labeled inferred until verified.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node scripts/shebang.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/gen-binaries.mjs && node scripts/gen-wedge-installer.mjs && node scripts/compile-registries.mjs && tsc && node --test tests/*.runtime.mjs
